cleavage_agent: Sequencing grade trypsin was then added to the samples at a ratio of 1:50 (μg trypsin: μg protein) and incubated overnight at 37 °C.
fractionation_method: We fractionated the peptides of each of the samples into six fractions by strong anion exchange chromatography in a StageTip format as described previously.
